I've had 1000s of you ask how to actually implement the strategy I showed in this video...So I'm hosting a live 'AI Masterclass' this weekend on how I built an AI store from scratch.

Register here (FREE for the first 500): https://www.aicom.co/masterclass
Nobody will teach you how to make money unless you are the reason they are making money

That bit about scaling with paid ads not being a long term win stuck with me because the creator keeps showing ad funnels like thats the growth lever. I ran a small dropshipping store for two years and spent every spare hour juggling suppliers and customer messages. It cost me a year of work and constant ad burn before I realised I was literally selling time and refunds. I found a physical copy of the book Algorithmic Freedom and the chapter on marginal delivery cost — the line about the next copy costing nearly nothing — was the one that wouldnt leave me. I built a downloadable course of niche product selection prompts and a tiny tool that generates validated product briefs, so handing over another copy costs me nothing. Within two weeks of posting the first short it covered a whole month of the old store and then some.
I just popped out of my mom and the nurse showed me this vid. already made 69 doller in sales! Thank you
